description: This source file implements the LocationHandler class for WebRTC streaming in the Cuttlefish project. It handles location messages by communicating with a GNSS client and sending GPS location data to a server via gRPC.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Handles location messages and communicates with GNSS client to send GPS data.

methods.name: LocationHandler
methods.description: Constructor for LocationHandler, takes a callback to send data to client.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes location data (longitude, latitude, elevation), retrieves configuration, and sends GPS locations via GNSS client.
